from django.test import RequestFactory
from django.contrib.auth.models import AnonymousUser
from django.contrib.sessions.middleware import SessionMiddleware
from django.contrib.messages.middleware import MessageMiddleware
from allauth.account.views import SignupView
from allauth.utils import get_request_param

def test_email_prefill_from_get():
    """Test that email GET parameter is used to prefill the form"""
    factory = RequestFactory()
    request = factory.get('/accounts/signup/?email=test@example.com')
    
    # Add middleware
    SessionMiddleware(lambda req: None).process_request(request)
    MessageMiddleware(lambda req: None).process_request(request)
    request.user = AnonymousUser()
    request.session = {}
    
    # Create view instance
    view = SignupView()
    view.request = request
    
    # Get initial data
    initial = view.get_initial()
    
    print("Initial data:", initial)
    assert 'email' in initial, "Email should be in initial data"
    assert initial['email'] == 'test@example.com', f"Expected 'test@example.com', got {initial['email']}"
    print("✓ Email prefill from GET parameter works correctly!")

def test_get_request_param_helper():
    """Test the get_request_param helper function"""
    factory = RequestFactory()
    request = factory.get('/accounts/signup/?email=test@example.com&other=value')
    
    # Test getting email parameter
    email = get_request_param(request, 'email')
    assert email == 'test@example.com', f"Expected 'test@example.com', got {email}"
    
    # Test getting other parameter
    other = get_request_param(request, 'other')
    assert other == 'value', f"Expected 'value', got {other}"
    
    # Test getting non-existent parameter with default
    missing = get_request_param(request, 'missing', 'default_value')
    assert missing == 'default_value', f"Expected 'default_value', got {missing}"
    
    print("✓ get_request_param helper works correctly!")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_get_request_param_helper()
    test_email_prefill_from_get()
    print("\n✅ All tests passed!")

#!/usr/bin/env python
from allauth.utils import get_request_param

def test_get_request_param():
    """Test the get_request_param helper function"""
    # Mock request object
    class MockRequest:
        def __init__(self, get_params):
            self.GET = get_params
            self.POST = {}
    
    # Test with email parameter
    request = MockRequest({'email': 'test@example.com'})
    email = get_request_param(request, 'email')
    assert email == 'test@example.com', f"Expected 'test@example.com', got {email}"
    
    # Test with other parameter
    request = MockRequest({'other': 'value'})
    other = get_request_param(request, 'other')
    assert other == 'value', f"Expected 'value', got {other}"
    
    # Test getting non-existent parameter with default
    request = MockRequest({})
    missing = get_request_param(request, 'missing', 'default_value')
    assert missing == 'default_value', f"Expected 'default_value', got {missing}"
    
    # Test POST takes precedence over GET
    request = MockRequest({'email': 'get@example.com'})
    request.POST = {'email': 'post@example.com'}
    email = get_request_param(request, 'email')
    assert email == 'post@example.com', f"Expected 'post@example.com', got {email}"
    
    print("✓ get_request_param helper works correctly!")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_get_request_param()
    print("\n✅ Helper function test passed!")

#!/usr/bin/env python

def get_request_param(request, param, default=None):
    """Copy of the function from allauth.utils"""
    if request is None:
        return default
    return request.POST.get(param) or request.GET.get(param, default)

def test_get_request_param():
    """Test the get_request_param helper function"""
    # Mock request object
    class MockRequest:
        def __init__(self, get_params, post_params=None):
            self.GET = get_params
            self.POST = post_params or {}
    
    # Test with email parameter
    request = MockRequest({'email': 'test@example.com'})
    email = get_request_param(request, 'email')
    assert email == 'test@example.com', f"Expected 'test@example.com', got {email}"
    
    # Test with other parameter
    request = MockRequest({'other': 'value'})
    other = get_request_param(request, 'other')
    assert other == 'value', f"Expected 'value', got {other}"
    
    # Test getting non-existent parameter with default
    request = MockRequest({})
    missing = get_request_param(request, 'missing', 'default_value')
    assert missing == 'default_value', f"Expected 'default_value', got {missing}"
    
    # Test POST takes precedence over GET
    request = MockRequest({'email': 'get@example.com'}, {'email': 'post@example.com'})
    email = get_request_param(request, 'email')
    assert email == 'post@example.com', f"Expected 'post@example.com', got {email}"
    
    print("✓ get_request_param helper works correctly!")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_get_request_param()
    print("\n✅ Helper function test passed!")
